Spreadsheet Viewer · Beta

Spreadsheet viewer

Open and browse spreadsheets on this device. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Spreadsheet Viewer has these main features: Opens XLSX, CSV and TSV, several files as tabs; Sort and filter any column, then export what you see. It opens Excel (.xlsx), Excel (.xls), CSV, TSV.

Beta: still being tested, so some parts may change.
